choosePath.title: How would you like to start?

intake.title: An introductory chat
intake.body: 20 to 30 minutes. It helps us suggest the best-fitting therapist, and you won't have to tell your story again from the start.
intake.note: You can pause and come back within 14 days

direct.title: I know what I want, I'll book directly
direct.body: You only answer the short safety questions (two minutes), then choose a therapist from the list.

choosePath.talkPrompt: Would you rather talk to a person from the start?
choosePath.talkLink: Ask the team to contact you
choosePath.contactSent: We've received your request. Someone from the team will contact you soon using the contact details you registered.
